10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: The 1st Gwent Battalion was a Welsh 'Pals battalion' formed as part of 'Kitchener's Army' during World War I. A flood of volunteers poured into the recruiting offices across the country and were formed into 'Service' battalions of the county regiments and the 'first hundred thousand' were enlisted within days.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: The recruits were assembled at the regimental depot of the South Wales Borderers (SWB) at Brecon, and by 4 December the 1st Gwent, now the 10th (Service) Battalion, SWB, was 320 strong.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: By March _____ it was well over its establishment strength and was able to form 'E' Company as a depot and draft-finding company
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: By March 1915 it was well over its establishment strength and was able to form 'E' Company as a depot and draft-finding company. In April 1915 the Fourth New Army (K4) was converted into reserve units for K1–K3, and the K5 formations took over their numbers: thus 130th Bde became 115th Bde in 38th (Welsh) Division on 29 April; at the same time the over-ambitious plan for a complete Welsh Army Corps was scaled back to this.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: But with units scattered across North Wales there was no opportunity for divisional training.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: On 3 December 10th SWB under Lt-Col Greenwood left Hazeley Down for Southampton and crossed to Le Havre that night, landing the following day. It then went by train to join the divisional concentration at Aire on 6 December and marched to its training area at Quernes.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: It remained at the Curragh after 65th Division was disbanded in March 1918.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: 10th SWB was billeted at Robecq and parties were attached to the Guards Division for their introduction to the front line. It completed its training at Robecq and from mid-January 1916 it began a long sequence of tours of duty in the trenches between the La Bassée Canal and Fauquissart, at Festubert in February and March, or at Givenchy in April, alternating with spells in brigade or divisional reserve.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture

At Colwyn Bay the battalion joined 130th (3rd Welsh) Brigade of 43rd Division (1st Division, Welsh Army Corps), serving alongside 17th (S) Bn, Royal Welsh Fusiliers (2nd North Welsh) (17th RWF), 11th (S) Bn, SWB (2nd Gwent), and 16th (S) Bn, Welsh Regiment (Cardiff City).

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: By March 1915 it was well over its establishment strength and was able to form 'E' _____ as a depot and draft-finding company
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: By March 1915 it was well over its establishment strength and was able to form 'E' Company as a depot and draft-finding company.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: It remained at the _____ after 65th Division was disbanded in March 1918

It remained at the Curragh after 65th Division was disbanded in March 1918.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: Brigadier-_____J. Evans of 115th Bde summoned Lt-Col Wilkinson and ordered him to send up two companies of 10th SWB, supported by the other two
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: Brigadier-General H.J. Evans of 115th Bde summoned Lt-Col Wilkinson and ordered him to send up two companies of 10th SWB, supported by the other two.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: It eventually attacked, with _____ personally leading the second wave, but gained nothing, the Hammerhead remaining out of reach
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: Brigadier-General H.J. Evans of 115th Bde summoned Lt-Col Wilkinson and ordered him to send up two companies of 10th SWB, supported by the other two. Wilkinson was ordered to press home the attack 'with vigour'.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: None of the infantry could get within _____ (230 m) of the Hammerhead, and were lying out in the valley under fire, tired out and wet through from the rain
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: None of the infantry could get within 250 yards (230 m) of the Hammerhead, and were lying out in the valley under fire, tired out and wet through from the rain.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: 10th SWB's casualties had been relatively low: 2 ORs killed and about 30 wounded, but Lt-_____ died of his wounds
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: 10th SWB's casualties had been relatively low: 2 ORs killed and about 30 wounded, but Lt-Col Wilkinson died of his wounds.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: The second-in-command, _____, was promoted to take over the command from him
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: The second-in-command, Maj Charles Harvey, was promoted to take over the command from him.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: At 16.00 10th SWB attacked with dash, making good initial progress and taking some prisoners, while the fleeing _____ were caught by 11th SWB's fire from Caterpillar Wood and Marlborough Copse
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: The attack made progress into the wood from the south, but bogged down in the Hammerhead, where the Germans counter-attacked. At 16.00 10th SWB attacked with dash, making good initial progress and taking some prisoners, while the fleeing Germans were caught by 11th SWB's fire from Caterpillar Wood and Marlborough Copse.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: Elsewhere the attack was less successful, but by the end of the day the southern half of _____ was in the division's hands, with 10th SWB holding most of the Hammerhead
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: Elsewhere the attack was less successful, but by the end of the day the southern half of Mametz Wood was in the division's hands, with 10th SWB holding most of the Hammerhead.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: During the night 115th Bde took over control of the fighting and at 11.40 next morning _____ was ordered to make a new attack to take the rest of the wood
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: During the night 115th Bde took over control of the fighting and at 11.40 next morning Evans was ordered to make a new attack to take the rest of the wood.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: Brigadier-Gen Evans and Maj Harvey were both wounded and on his own initiative, Lt-Col J.R. Gaussen of 11th SWB collected detachments of 10th SWB to reinforce his battalion.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: Eventually two companies of 11th and 10th SWB fought their way through to the northern edge of _____ and dug in
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: Eventually two companies of 11th and 10th SWB fought their way through to the northern edge of Mametz Wood and dug in. 10th SWB's total casualties in Mametz Wood had risen to 3 officers and 29 ORs killed and wounded, together with 9 officers and 140 ORs wounded.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: 10th SWB's total casualties in _____ had risen to 3 officers and 29 ORs killed and wounded, together with 9 officers and 140 ORs wounded
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: Eventually two companies of 11th and 10th SWB fought their way through to the northern edge of Mametz Wood and dug in. 10th SWB's total casualties in Mametz Wood had risen to 3 officers and 29 ORs killed and wounded, together with 9 officers and 140 ORs wounded.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: With his men exhausted and under constant bombardment, _____ reluctantly withdrew the men into the interior of the wood
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: Brigadier-Gen Evans and Maj Harvey were both wounded and on his own initiative, Lt-Col J.R. Gaussen of 11th SWB collected detachments of 10th SWB to reinforce his battalion. With his men exhausted and under constant bombardment, Gaussen reluctantly withdrew the men into the interior of the wood.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: Two days after being relieved, 10th SWB was back in the line in the _____ sector, albeit at Hébuterne where the fighting had died down after 1 July
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: Two days after being relieved, 10th SWB was back in the line in the Somme sector, albeit at Hébuterne where the fighting had died down after 1 July. Casualties were light in late 1916 (10th SWB suffered 1 officer and 8 ORs killed or missing, 1 officer and 49 ORs wounded), but the drain on resources on the Somme front meant that the battalions in the Salient received few reinforcements, and remained considerably understrength.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: At the end of July the division moved to the _____, where it held trenches facing Pilckem Ridge, spending the time improving the trenches and carrying out raids
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: At the end of July the division moved to the Ypres Salient, where it held trenches facing Pilckem Ridge, spending the time improving the trenches and carrying out raids.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: Early in _____ the enemy shelling increased, the 10th SWB losing 8 killed and 33 wounded in the first four months of the year
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: On 27 December Lt-Col Harvey (recovered from his wound and promoted to permanent command of 10th SWB) reported that he could not find enough men to garrison all the positions required by the divisional defence scheme, but it was not until March 1917 that the battalion received any substantial reinforcements (244 in the month). Early in 1917 the enemy shelling increased, the 10th SWB losing 8 killed and 33 wounded in the first four months of the year.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: The battalion also received a draft of 112 men in _____
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: The Germans seem to have regarded this as a feint, and took little notice: 10th SWB got away with only 3 men killed and 1 officer and 15 ORs wounded in May–June despite suffering a destructive bombardment on 3 June. The battalion also received a draft of 112 men in June.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: 10th SWB marched up to the _____ concentration area on 29 July and started for the assembly position soon after dark the following night
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: 10th SWB marched up to the Corps concentration area on 29 July and started for the assembly position soon after dark the following night.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: It left one company at the _____ to help lay bridges, while the other three took up their assembly positions in divisional reserve
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: It left one company at the Yser Canal to help lay bridges, while the other three took up their assembly positions in divisional reserve.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: Then two battalions of 115th Bde were to pass through and descend from _____ to capture the line of the Steenbeek stream (the 'Green Dotted Line')
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: Then two battalions of 115th Bde were to pass through and descend from Iron Cross Ridge to capture the line of the Steenbeek stream (the 'Green Dotted Line').

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: As the attack progressed, 10th SWB moved up to the old _____ front line; although it suffered a few casualties from shellfire it arrived at 'Kiel Cottage' on schedule at 06.50
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: As the attack progressed, 10th SWB moved up to the old German front line; although it suffered a few casualties from shellfire it arrived at 'Kiel Cottage' on schedule at 06.50. Although the Germans began collecting for a counter-attack, runners from the front found it difficult and dangerous to move through the heavy shelling, which also cut any telephone lines the signallers had been able to lay.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: The men took shelter in '_____' to await further orders
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: The men took shelter in 'Caddy Lane' to await further orders.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: and were forced back over the _____
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: and were forced back over the Steenbeek. During the afternoon it had begun to rain, and the positions in the Steenbeek valley became very muddy, hindering all further movement.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: During the afternoon 10th SWB moved up to the _____ and began digging in while D Company was sent forward to reinforce 11th SWB as it consolidated its position
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: During the afternoon 10th SWB moved up to the Iron Cross Ridge and began digging in while D Company was sent forward to reinforce 11th SWB as it consolidated its position.

10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.subject: Fisheries & Aquaculture
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.question: By now communications to the rear were working, and a second _____ attack was stopped by artillery, Lewis gun and rifle fire
10th (Service) Battalion, South Wales Bo.fact: By now communications to the rear were working, and a second German attack was stopped by artillery, Lewis gun and rifle fire.
